correctness.rationale: Over any field of characteristic p>0, ∂x and ∂y have p-th power zero, yielding D^p=E^p=0. Every derivation kills t=x^p y^p, so (DE)^n(x)=t^n x and H^n(x)=t^n x for H=[D,E]; monomial independence proves associative infinite-dimensionality and failure of local finiteness of H. Writing D=x^p(x∂y), E=y^p(y∂x), H=t(x∂x−y∂y) gives [D_i,E_j]=H_{i+j}, [H_i,D_j]=2D_{i+j+1}, [H_i,E_j]=−2E_{i+j+1}. For odd p all current families are generated and linearly independent by x/y monomial supports. For p=2 the 2 coefficients vanish, leaving 3D Heisenberg Lie algebra, but central H=DE+ED and square-zero D,E generate the rank-four K[H] envelope on {1,D,E,DE}; monomial actions on x,y show independence and K[T] is a polynomial algebra. Valid for arbitrary nonperfect K, char2 included. Inspected finite monomial tests supplement these symbolic unrestricted proofs.
